dct_description_sm: The main goal of this project was to initiate the collection of climate-related data in Atlin and the surrounding mountainous region in order to understand mountain climates and to model the regional distribution of permafrost. The specific objectives of the project were: (1) to collect data via weather stations to provide ongoing information for planning and decision-making based on local climatic conditions and any changes to trends; (2) to create an air and ground temperature network to provide information on lapse rates and snow depths in order to undertake detailed spatial modelling of permafrost in the area; (3) to provide a means to inform and engage local school-age children in meaningful research through the monitoring project; and (4) to ensure that ongoing procedures are in place to gather data in a timely fashion and share it in a usable form with other climate research projects and community members.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Acquisition of Mountain Climate Data for Atlin's Climate Adaptation Strategies and Permafrost Distribution Modelling
